entities.summary: Princess Olga Isabelle of Savoy-Aosta, Duchess of Aosta, is the younger daughter of author Prince Michael of Greece and Denmark and Marina Karella, an artist and daughter of the Greek business magnate Theódoros Karéllas. Olga is married to her second cousin Prince Aimone, Duke of Aosta.
